## Derived questions

Produced by induction failure, not written by hand.

**C_SELF_SUPPORTED**: F_A1 and F_B1 have identical recorded attributes, yet F_B1 is a counterexample to C_SELF_SUPPORTED. What distinguishes them?

1. a dimension that is not recorded yet (add an attribute)
2. one of the two examples is mislabelled (relabel)
3. the concept mixes two contexts and must be split (split)
